answer.text: The USB charger port is rated USB 2.0 Type C, 5 V, 2 A output.

watchouts.text: If the current draw is greater than 2.5 A, the USB charger shuts down, so check your smart phone battery current rating before using it.
The USB charger works only when the engine is running.
